reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Default registry flag: Removed: `--registry` flag for default package registry All packages must now use fully qualified names including the registry host name", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The `--registry` flag is no longer honored; packages without fully qualified registry host names will not resolve and must be updated before the upgrade completes.

proposed.statement: The `--registry` CLI flag for specifying a default package registry has been removed; all packages must now use fully qualified names including the registry host name.
